feats.name: Berserker Rage
feats.rankBenefit: Character’s temporary HP while in rage increases by ½ their BOD attribute. Character’s Bonus to Melee damage increases by ¼ their BOD attribute. Gain additional 2 rage stacks.
feats.description:
Character gains the ability to gain the Berserk Condition a number of times per day equal to ¼ BOD+1/Rank, gaining a number of stacks equal to 1/2 their BOD score +2/ Rank which dissipate at a rate of ¼ BOD score per round if not used. Each round, the Berserker can spend as much as 1+1/Rank Berserker stacks to do one of the following:
Gain an extra attack
Gain +2 (+1/Rank) to all attacks this turn
Gain +2 (+1/Rank) to all defense checks this turn
Gain +1d6 to all attacks this turn
Gain an additional 1/4 BOD to a BOD check or save
The Berserk Condition grants 1/4 BOD DR+1/Rank. Additionally, while having the Berserk Condition, you may remain conscious after being reduce below 0 HP.
The Berserk Condition inflicts -4 to MND saves.
After using Berserker Rage the maximum number of times per day, the Berserker can still use Berserker Rage but they gain a stack of exhaustion. Exhaustion inflicts a -2 on all checks per stack (which does effect their combat), and dissipates at a rate of 1 stack per full rest.

Boosted Bass
While the caster performs, enemies within 10+10 feet per rank must make a DC 15 + Caster Rank BOD save or receive a -2 to their BOD score as long as the performance lasts.
Captivate Audience
While the caster performs, all who witness the performance must make a DC 15 + ½ Performance Caster CHA MND save to leave the encounter. They can otherwise interact normally while staying within the encounter. This can be used in combat to make sure enemies don’t run away or it can be used outside of combat in order to provide a distraction.
Empower
While the caster performs, add an additional d4 per Caster Rank to spell effects that have numerical variables (such as damage or healing).
Limelight
While the caster performs, all casters who witness the performance and wish to cast a spell must make a DC 15 + Caster Rank spellcasting check. Those who fail the check fall to the bottom of the initiative chart and have a -2 on all spellcasting checks.
Performance of Fragility
While the caster performs, all who witness the performance must make a DC 15 + Caster Rank MND save. Those who fail the check will see the caster as a frail non-threat and will not prioritize them in combat. If the caster deals damage to an enemy, all enemies in the area can make another check against the DC.
Performance of Mockery
While the caster performs, all who witness the performance must make a DC 15 + Caster Rank MND save. Those who fail the check will see the caster as an unbearable nuisance and will prioritize them in combat.
Project
While the caster performs, add 1d4 per Caster Rank to spell targets or increase spell AOE by 5 feet per Caster Rank. Spell range is also increased by 10 feet per Caster Rank.
Shell Shock Shanty
While the caster performs, all allies within 10 + 10 feet per rank gain a +2 to defense checks. Enemies must make a DC 15 + Caster Rank MND save or receive a -2 on defense checks.

Divine Casters derive their power from a deity who serves as their patron or from unknown forces of fate. Whether through unwavering devotion, sacred rites, or an unexplainable connection to higher powers, they channel divine energy into spells and abilities that shape the world around them. Unlike arcane casters who manipulate raw magic, divine casters serve as conduits for celestial, infernal, or primordial will, their magic a reflection of the forces that guide them. All divine casters have access to an innate ability called Reveal Character.
Source Gift: Reveal Character
Divine casters have the uncanny ability to read people, allowing them to discern character traits regardless of the target’s stats and defenses. With a DC 15+Target Character Level Detect check, Divine casters are given a word that defines a character trait the character has. The target of this ability will have no knowledge that they were targeted by the ability. Regardless of whether the check has succeeded or failed, another check cannot be performed on the same target until 24 hours have passed. This can be used on the same target multiple times and each time the GM may choose to reveal something new or simply go back to an already revealed trait.

Nature Casters draw their power from the primal forces of the natural world—ancient forests, rolling oceans, towering mountains, and the life energy woven into every living thing. Their magic is not learned through study or granted by divine favor, but through an intrinsic connection to the rhythms and cycles of nature itself. Whether they revere the spirits of the land, embody the essence of natural phenomena, or are simply vessels through which nature’s will flows, Nature Casters channel raw, untamed energy to shape and manipulate the environment around them. Their spells often reflect the harmony and chaos found in the natural world, blending growth, decay, and elemental power. All Nature Casters have access to an innate ability called Veiled Casting.
Source Gift: Veiled Casting
Nature Casters weave their magic seamlessly into the fabric of the natural world, making their spells indistinguishable from the environment around them. Spells cast by a Nature Caster cannot be detected by Detect Magic, divination spells, or any other magical means of identifying active or residual magic. The only way to recognize a Nature Caster’s magic is to witness the spell being cast and succeed on a Knowledge Magic check with a DC equal to 15 + the caster’s level. This innate ability makes Nature Casters exceptionally elusive, allowing their influence to ripple through the world like an unseen breeze.

feats.description:
Casting Attribute: CHA
The Shaman of Beasts channels the primal essence of nature, calling beasts to their aid and embodying their forms. The caster gains a manapool (10+MND) and 3 Caster Points. If taken at first level, they begin with 1 additional Caster Point. To regain mana, the caster must meditate in a natural environment for 4 hours.
Trait- Animal Form: The Shaman learns spells through meditation, requiring at least 1 hour in nature to expend a Caster Point and add a spell to their known list. At Rank 0, they can shift into small or smaller animals, medium-sized animals at Rank 1, large animals at Rank 2, and huge animals at Rank 3 and beyond. At Rank 1, they gain the ability to transform into aquatic creatures, and at Rank 2, flying creatures. They gain the animal’s natural abilities, such as venom, webs, or keen senses, but cannot take the form of magical or monstrous creatures. If reduced to 0 HP in animal form, the Shaman reverts to their true form and falls unconscious instead of dying. They cannot speak or cast spells while transformed but may remain in animal form indefinitely. Shamans of Beasts do not learn spells from books.
